source.source_name: GitHub Actions artifact SHA-256 digest verification behavior
source.purpose: Official behavior of artifact SHA256 mismatch when download-artifact verifies uploaded artifacts
source.cost_quota: free public official changelog; no key required
source.reliability_limits: Documented for artifact actions v4+ as of March 18, 2025; behavior may change in later versions, verify before enforcement

learning.title: GitHub Actions artifact digest mismatch needs explicit fail-closed gate
learning.claim: GitHub Actions artifact digest mismatch is only a warning during download; it does not fail the workflow automatically.
learning.decision: When an artifact from another workflow/run is consumed for a plan decision or applied_learning_ids, a digest mismatch must cause an explicit nonzero integrity gate; successful download alone is not a PASS.
learning.next_measurement: Create a downstream consumer negative test with a mismatched digest; require nonzero exit and no applied_learning_ids assertion; record run ID, artifact digest and test SHA.
fallback_history: If expected digest is unavailable, mark cross-run artifact integrity unverified; do not claim the plan consumed verified artifact content.
